guestProgressAccountBody: Create a free account so you do not lose what you learned if you clear this browser or switch devices.
signInLocalProgressBody: This device already has learning progress. You can include it in your account, or turn the switch off to use only what is already on the account.
signInLocalProgressMergeHint: Off = use only what is already on the account (this device’s progress is not kept).
guestAccountTourBody: Whenever you want, create a free account here to sync.
onboardingLoginSigningInBanner: Connecting to the network… this can take a few seconds. Please don't close or reload the tab.
onboardingRegisterCreatingBanner: Creating your account… this can take a few seconds. Please don't close or reload the tab.
registerSyncLocalDone: Local courses synced to your account.
onboardingSessionSubtitle: Use your online account to sync progress across devices.
onboardingNetworkAcceptNote: By continuing you accept the privacy policy and enable the public network. You can change this later in Privacy & data.
onboardingLocalOnlyPromptBody: Arborito will be very limited: no online catalog, share codes, forums, sync, or publishing. To confirm, type localonly.
onboardingLocalOnlyConfirmBody: Arborito will be very limited: no online catalog, share codes, forums, sync, or publishing. Only trees on this device and manual import. You can enable the network later from Privacy & data.
onboardingNetworkBundleHint: Use the recommended bundle so teachers and learners see the same course.
onboardingNetworkMinOne: Choose at least one server or turn off the public network.
guestAccountHintTip: Progress stays on this device — tap to create an account
